actions.createAndQueryDB.description: Create DB from data and run query
actions.createAndQueryDB.props.args.desc: Arguments to be used in the query
**DO NOT** insert dynamic input directly into the query string. Instead, use $1, $2, $3 and add them in args for parameterized queries to prevent **SQL injection.**
actions.createAndQueryDB.props.query.des: Please use $1, $2, etc. for parameterized queries to avoid SQL injection.
actions.createAndQueryDB.props.tables.de: List of tables to create in the database
actions.duckdb_compare_datasets.descript: Diff two JSON arrays of rows by key columns into added, removed and changed rows.
actions.duckdb_compare_datasets.props.af: The newer dataset: a JSON array of row objects. May be empty.
actions.duckdb_compare_datasets.props.be: The older dataset: a JSON array of row objects. May be empty.
actions.duckdb_compare_datasets.props.ke: Column names that identify a row on both sides, e.g. ["id"] or ["order_id", "line"]. Values must be unique within each side.
actions.duckdb_deduplicate_rows.descript: Remove duplicate rows from a JSON array, matching on key columns or on the whole row.
actions.duckdb_deduplicate_rows.props.ke: Which occurrence of each duplicate group to keep, by position in rows. Defaults to first.
Column names that identify a duplicate, e.g. ["email"]. Leave empty to treat only fully identical rows as duplicates.
actions.duckdb_deduplicate_rows.props.ro: A JSON array of row objects. May be empty.
actions.duckdb_describe_data.description: Detect the columns and DuckDB types of a JSON array of rows.
A JSON array of row objects, e.g. [{"id": 1, "email": "a@b.co"}]. At least one row.
actions.duckdb_run_query.description: Load JSON rows as tables in a temporary in-memory DuckDB and run one SQL query over them.
actions.duckdb_run_query.props.params.de: A JSON array of values bound to $1, $2, … in the query, in order, e.g. ["IN", 10, null]. Strings, numbers, booleans or null.
actions.duckdb_run_query.props.query.des: One DuckDB SQL statement over the tables above, e.g. SELECT c.name, sum(o.total) AS spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ALL. Quote table or column names that are not plain identifiers with double quotes.
actions.duckdb_run_query.props.tables.de: A JSON object mapping each table name to its rows, e.g. {"orders": [{"id": 1, "total": 9.5}], "customers": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ann"}]}. Columns come from the row keys and types are detected from the values; a nested object stays one STRUCT column, queried with dot notation (meta.city). Each table needs at least one row.
actions.duckdb_summarize_data.descriptio: Per-column statistics (min, max, distinct count, average, quartiles, null %) for a JSON array of rows.
actions.duckdb_summarize_data.props.rows: A JSON array of row objects, e.g. [{"id": 1, "amount": 12.5}]. At least one row.
description: Run SQL queries on an in-memory DuckDB database.
